lines.en: I point to the couch behind her and she looks back and forth between it and me, trying to wrap her head around what’s going on.
lines.zh: 我指了指她身后的沙发，她在我和沙发之间来回看着，努力想弄明白现在到底是什么情况。

lines.en: Of course I’m not planning on actually making her stay quiet while we’re in here. I just think it might be fun pushing her buttons a bit.
lines.zh: 当然，我并不打算真的让她在这里一直保持安静。我只是觉得，稍微逗一逗她也许会很有意思。

lines.en: Especially after she fell so easily for the whole “You’re a pervert” thing when I fingered her for the first time.
lines.zh: 尤其是我第一次用手指插她的时候，她那么轻易就上了「你是个变态」的当之后。

lines.en: Only two minutes have passed, but Chika has not broken eye contact with me the entire time.
lines.zh: 才过了两分钟，Chika 却自始至终没有挪开盯着我的视线。

lines.en: : What did you think detention entailed exactly?
lines.zh: : 你以为留堂到底是要干什么？

lines.en: : I don’t know, but it sure as heck wasn’t actual {i}detention.{/i}
lines.zh: : 我不知道，但绝对不是真正的{i}留堂{/i}。

lines.en: : Chika, take a second to think about what you just said.
lines.zh: : Chika，花一秒钟想想你刚刚说了什么。

lines.en: : No. How about {i}you{/i} take a second to think about {i}your{/i} actions?
lines.zh: : 不。不如{i}你{/i}花一秒钟想想{i}你自己的{/i}行为？

lines.en: : How the heck are you gonna get all close to a girl in a dressing room and be like “See me after class” or whatever and not expect her to think things are gonna happen.
lines.zh: : 你怎么能做到在试衣间里把女生逼得那么近、还说什么「下课后见我」之类的话，却指望她不往那方面想？

lines.en: : So you want things to happen?
lines.zh: : 所以你想让事情发生？

lines.en: : Of course I want things to happen.
lines.zh: : 我当然想让事情发生。

lines.en: : I like you and it’s not fair that I’m the only one who ever gets to have any fun.
lines.zh: : 我喜欢你，而只有我一个人能得到快乐，这太不公平了。

lines.en: : Also I’m pretty sure your penis is huge from the one time I touched it and not knowing that for a fact is driving me insane.
lines.zh: : 而且，就凭我摸到的那一次，我敢肯定你的阴茎很大，可我没法确认这一点，简直要逼疯我了。

lines.en: : Oh and also, I’m not perverted. And you’re being a jerk.
lines.zh: : 还有，我才不是变态。而你是个混蛋。

lines.en: : Is this a Chika Chosokabe temper tantrum? I have to say, I thought you were a little more mature than this.
lines.zh: : 这是 Chika Chosokabe 式的耍脾气吗？我得说，我还以为你比这成熟一点呢。

lines.en: : A temper tantrum? Sure. If that’s what you want to call it. But to me it just seems like you’re afraid of doing something with a student in your office.
lines.zh: : 耍脾气？行啊，你想这么叫就这么叫。但在我看来，你只是害怕在自己的办公室里和学生做点什么。

lines.en: : I can assure you that is most definitely not the case.
lines.zh: : 我可以向你保证，绝对不是这么回事。

lines.en: : Then what is the case, Sensei? Do you want me to beg?
lines.zh: : 那是怎么回事，Sensei？你想让我求你吗？

lines.en: : On the contrary. I just think it’s fun to mess around with you.
lines.zh: : 恰恰相反。我只是觉得逗你玩很有意思。

lines.en: : I was actually just about to sit down before you started scowling at me.
lines.zh: : 在你开始瞪我之前，我本来正准备坐下的。

lines.en: : Well, now I certainly feel dumb.
lines.zh: : 好吧，我现在确实觉得自己挺蠢的。

lines.en: : But I guess...I {i}am{/i} a little relieved that you're not bored of me yet.
lines.zh: : 不过我猜……你还没对我厌倦，我{i}确实{/i}有点松了口气。

lines.en: : I’ll never get bored of you if you keep turning red like that. You {i}are{/i} normally pretty mature, but you have quite the cute side sometimes, Chika.
lines.zh: : 你要是能一直这样脸红，我永远不会对你厌倦。你{i}平时{/i}确实挺成熟的，但有时候也有相当可爱的一面，Chika。

lines.en: : Thanks...but, umm, now that you’re being forward about it, I kinda have no idea what to do.
lines.zh: : 谢谢……不过，呃，现在你这么直接，我反倒不知道该怎么办了。
: 什么意思？

lines.en: : I mean I’m clearly not as much of a seductress as I thought I would be. And now you’re the one seducing me instead.
lines.zh: : 我的意思是，我显然没有自己以为的那么会勾引人。现在反而变成你在勾引我了。

lines.en: : I’m not seducing you, I’m just being honest.
lines.zh: : 我不是在勾引你，我只是实话实说。
: 实话？

lines.en: I take a seat next to Chika on the couch and rest my arm behind her. She immediately moves in closer despite currently being a bit more timid than she normally is.
lines.zh: 我在 Chika 身边的沙发上坐下，把手臂搭在她身后。尽管她此刻比平时羞怯一些，还是立刻靠了过来。

lines.en: Her face turns a darker shade of red as she looks into my eyes.
lines.zh: 她望着我的眼睛，脸涨得更红了。

lines.en: : I’m being honest when I say you’re cute. And that I won’t get bored of you.
lines.zh: : 我说你可爱，是实话。说我不会对你厌倦，也是实话。

lines.en: : Good. You better not. Because I wouldn’t have let you touch me if I thought you were just gonna bail on me once you found someone else.
lines.zh: : 那就好。你最好是这样。因为要是你觉得找到别人就会甩掉我，我是不会让你碰我的。

lines.en: : Someone like me bailing on someone like you isn’t exactly something that happens every day. That won’t happen.
lines.zh: : 像我这样的人甩掉像你这样的人，可不是天天都会发生的事。那不会发生。

lines.en: : I might not be the smartest guy out there, but I’m not an idiot.
lines.zh: : 我也许不是世上最聪明的人，但我也不傻。
: 说得对……

lines.en: : You’d be the biggest idiot in the whole world.
lines.zh: : 那你就是全世界最大的傻瓜。
: 一个巨大的傻瓜。
: 一个{i}超大号{/i}的傻瓜……

lines.en: Understanding where this is going, I elect to do what any sane man would do in my position and stay silent, waiting for her to inevitably make her move.
lines.zh: 明白事情会往哪个方向发展，我选择做任何一个理智男人处在我这个位置都会做的事：保持沉默，等她自己动手。
: Sensei~~~
: 什么？
: 我……能把它拿出来吗？拜托？
: 我想看看它。
: 我不反对。

lines.en: : Really? Cause the one time I tried, you pushed me down and took my finger-virginity.
lines.zh: : 真的吗？因为我上次想试的时候，你把我推倒，夺走了我的手指贞操。
: 手指贞操这种东西是不存在的，Chika。

lines.en: : Shut up, yes it is. Now show me your penis.
lines.zh: : 闭嘴，存在。现在把你的阴茎给我看。
: 某人今天可真够主动的。

lines.en: : Yes. And that someone is about to take your pants off, so please bear with me.
lines.zh: : 没错。而这个人马上就要脱你的裤子了，请忍耐一下。

lines.en: Chika lays down beside me on the couch and unzips my pants, sliding them down shortly after.
lines.zh: Chika 在我身边躺下，拉开我裤子的拉链，随即把裤子往下褪。

lines.en: Well, she {i}tries{/i} to slide them down, at least. She can only reach one side, so I have to assist her.
lines.zh: 好吧，至少她{i}试着{/i}往下褪了。她只够得到一边，所以我得帮她一把。
然后……
: 我操！

lines.en: : Yeah, I was more or less expecting that reaction.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我多少预料到你会是这个反应。
: 老兄！

lines.en: : That will be inside of you one day.
lines.zh: : 总有一天，它会进到你的里面。
: 我？！怎么进？！这根本不可能！

lines.en: : I don’t know. We’ll figure something out.
lines.zh: : 我不知道。我们会想出办法的。

lines.en: : Uhhhh yeah, I don’t know about that.
lines.zh: : 呃呃呃，这个我可说不好。

lines.en: : I’m pretty sure I’d actually die.
lines.zh: : 我很确定我会当场死掉。

lines.en: : I’ll just give you handjobs or something for the rest of eternity.
lines.zh: : 那我就给你打一辈子的飞机好了。

lines.en: : You’ll cave. I can feel it.
lines.zh: : 你会让步的。我感觉得到。

lines.en: : Jesus Christ it’s bigger than my little sister.
lines.zh: : 天哪，它比我妹妹还大。
: 好了，它没{i}那么{/i}大……
: 我的手摸起来怎么样？
: 特别软。而且很暖。
: 谢谢。我涂护手霜的。
: 那……挺好的。

lines.en: : Yeah, the really expensive kind. Yumi stole it from some flea market and gave it to me as a birthday present.
lines.zh: : 嗯，很贵的那种。Yumi 从某个跳蚤市场顺来的，当作生日礼物送给了我。

lines.en: : Is this your idea of dirty-talk? Because it’s definitely a strange strategy.
lines.zh: : 这就是你心目中的情色挑逗吗？这策略可真够奇怪的。

lines.en: : What? Talking about my hands doesn’t turn you on?
lines.zh: : 什么？聊我的手不能让你兴奋吗？
: 我……不觉得。

lines.en: : Then what {i}would{/i} turn you on, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 那{i}什么{/i}能让你兴奋呢，Sensei？

lines.en: : Well, for one...not calling me Sensei anymore would help.
lines.zh: : 嗯，首先……别再叫我 Sensei 会有点帮助。

lines.en: : Wait, really? Then...what would you like me to call you instead?
lines.zh: : 等等，真的吗？那……你想让我怎么称呼你？
: 不如……
